dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Four prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures in the mid-dorsal and posterior regions exhibit high-contrast, jagged white perimeters with an abrupt gradient transition from the dark exterior field to a lighter, mottled interior. The geometries are irregular and non-concentric.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate spatial density of solid high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the interstitial spaces between macro-annuli along the lower lateral-ventral transition.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an obtuse scalene triangle with the longest side oriented nearly parallel to the dorsal ridge.
